foundations.rationale: The final owner direction removes Gradient rather than promoting an unresolved experiment. Remaining descriptions explain implemented systems and identify evidence without institutional claims.

copy.rationale: Gradient About copy is removed. Seven requested About revisions remain: Circles, Circles Gradient, Numeric, Grid, Triangles, Union and Artemis. Naming, credits and plain-language model limits remain grounded in the full Naming and Voice & Tone sources.

interface.rationale: Gradient is absent from picker, About, controls and Home; old routes, queries and snapshots recover to Solid. Circles Gradient remains intact. Chromium/WebKit checks cover all three retired styles, recovered SVG export, Circles Gradient and 390px keyboard disclosure. Remaining fonts, palette and focus semantics are unchanged.

bar-and-exports.rationale: Gradient geometry helper, preview/SVG rendering branches and controls are removed. There is no replacement exposure-step model or brightness-chart claim. Recovered states use the existing official Solid geometry, verified through actual SVG export. Other pattern geometry and the shared fixed viewport remain unchanged.

media.rationale: The obsolete generated Gradient Home SVGs and candidate review image are removed. A project-only picker screenshot and the existing Artemis review capture document remaining UI. No new production media, font, photo, seal, spirit mark or external art is introduced.

assets-and-approvals.rationale: Read the actual asset-permission record; existing unresolved font/brand/artwork permissions remain open. Only generated Gradient samples and its obsolete review screenshot are deleted. Original reference artwork, official captured sources and licenses are retained. New picker screenshot contains existing project UI/assets only.

governance.rationale: Read all 17 captured pages and source coverage/manifest. Record the owner’s narrowly scoped November 18 product decision in brand_conflicts.md without altering official sources, checks or claiming formal approval.

existingConflicts.disposition: The owner’s final November 18 request retires Gradient entirely, superseding the attempted exposure-step models. Circles Gradient and other B01–B10 source/approval questions remain unchanged. Original official sources and reference assets are retained; retirement is not formal RPI approval.

approvalRationale: Owner explicitly requested removal of the entire Gradient bar. Retiring the style and recovering old states to existing Solid introduces no new identity asset, palette, measurement claim or institutional lockup. Existing institutional approvals remain separate.
approvalEvidence: Final November 18 session instruction: remove the entire bar as is. Implemented as Gradient retirement; no branch deletion or merge is authorized by that request.
publicationScope: Owner-requested single PR for issues #212, #213, #215, #216, #219, #220, #221, #222, #223 and #226, including code, status/science/source records and original application review screenshots. No merge authorized in this session.
